notes: Chunk 104 has four pages, each with a single Common Crawl capture (no live copy); all four were readable, none unreadable. sourceUrl is the Common Crawl index lookup address from each file's footer; sourceDate is the date in the file name. (1) UBC Sauder 'Alumni Stories' (2018-02-25): a feature page with only three alumni profiles (OBHR, Finance, Marketing), not a graduate list; the year printed after the degree ('PhD OBHR, 2014') is unlabelled, so yearMeaning is 'unstated' (probably the degree year). The affiliations are those shown at capture, not stated first placements. No operations graduates. (2) UConn Management Ph.D. alumni (2020-09-24): 42 alumni written 'Name, ’YY Ph.D., Affiliation' followed by the dissertation title; the two-digit year is an alumni class-year tag next to the degree, recorded as yearMeaning 'class-of' following the convention used for UConn alumni profiles in earlier proposals (an integrator may prefer 'graduation'). The affiliation is the one printed at capture, which for older alumni is likely a later job rather than the first placement; position is never printed. Sharon Foley (’98) has no affiliation. Avinash Mainkar's line lacks the comma after 'Ph.D.' but is otherwise the same pattern. Brian Fox (’17, Bentley University) also appears on a separate UConn alumni-profile page in an earlier proposal. This is a management (OB/strategy) department list; no operations graduates expected. (3) UConn OPIM Ph.D. alumni (2020-09-23): 31 alumni in the same 'Name, ’YY Ph.D., Affiliation' + dissertation format, so the same class-of/affiliation caveats apply. This is the operations-relevant page: the OPIM department mixes operations and information systems; dissertation titles are kept in note so the integrator can judge field (e.g. Qindong Liu ’11 'Essays at the Interface of Finance and Operations Management', Preetam Basu ’10 'Essays at the Interface of Operations and Risk Management', Matthew Dean ’10 'Improving Decision Making in Healthcare Operations', Steven Thompson ’05). Several affiliations are industry (1010 Data, Dow Chemical, Technology Solutions Experts). Names copied as printed, including 'Kaveepan Lertwacuara' (the page's spelling) and 'Andrew N.K. Chen'. (4) UGA Terry Management PhD job candidates (2020-09-20): three 5th-year PhD candidates (two OB, one Strategy & Entrepreneurship) with no year, destination or advisor printed; listedYear null, yearMeaning 'job-market'. No operations candidates. No master's graduates, faculty, staff or advisors were recorded on any page; e-mail addresses on the UConn pages (department heads) belong to faculty and were not copied.
